Landing (Y reaches the shadow) ends the jump: clear

units.summary: Next motion script entry.

units.name: BgAnimStart
units.summary: Background tile-animation channel X: store animation id A (PasswordDigits+1,X, reused RAM), point Tmp at its entry list (BgAnimListPtr) and play the first entry: delay byte to PasswordDigits+7,X, PPU script id queued with PpuScriptQueue. BgClassMap+13,X holds the entry index. The list table is BgAni

units.name: BgAnimListPtr
units.summary: Tmp = word at BgAnimLists[(A & $7F)*2] (BgAnimLists is in bank 10, so pair 10/11 must be mapped).

units.name: BgAnimTick
units.summary: Count down the current entry's delay; at zero fetch the next entry: $FF restarts the list, anything else is played as the next PPU script.

units.name: BgAnimNextEntry
units.summary: Advance channel X to its next (delay, script) entry and return its first byte in A.

editorial_audit.notes:
Final editorial audit, round 4 (baseline pass-004, 2026-11-19). Scope: whole current source (commentary/source/game.asm), carried forward by physical range from round 3; review.json 1909 entries / 2117 units.
Checks performed: (1) every scaffold entry and unit reviewed with summary and source line (review.py); (2) symbol consistency: every CamelCase identifier used in comments was resolved against defined labels/equates - stale names fixed (BankPushAndMapPair, Var_C4, IntroStoryUpdate, EnemyAttackUpdate, AdvanceSubMode_Continue, StageRam660, StageStateDispatch, PlayerHurtPose, EndingCreditScripts/Sprites); remaining unresolved tokens are table families (JumpPose*, HitReact*, ParticleSpawn*), historical 'earlier name' notes or phase-1 evidence text; (3) stacked old/new comments: 10 contradicting round-1 notes removed; (4) misleading names: BossW2_Hit, BossW6_Hit -> *_StartAttack, BossW2_Defeat -> BossW2_IntroEnd, BossW4_Hit -> BossW4_IntroLeap; (5) numeric aliases: 0 numeric zero-page operands, 2 documented raw switchable-bank operands ($8000 bank-ID read, $8159 checksum), raw RAM addresses in prose replaced by symbols where named; 20 stale high-byte equates now Table+1; (6) stale state statements: no 'unclassified/unknown byte' statements remain; preamble updated to pass-004; the three fallback bytes (regions 1907-1909) are described as user-directed manual fallback data of unknown meaning (value $60 = RTS opcode, code-vs-data ambiguous, no reachability claim), not as evidence-backed data; (7) contradictions with the map: source region headers come from the pass-004 generator listing; byte-identical verify passes; (8) units without comments: all ~40 now commented; thin descriptions of ~12 large routines expanded; RAM usage notes regenerated from current source.
Spot-checked representative routines in banks 0, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 14, 15 (sound reader, player hurt/entry, boss states, vehicle stage, password encoder, credits, PPU string copy, object update loop).
Accepted residue (documented in commentary/uncertainties.md, explained in source): ~640 structurally named dispatch entries (<Owner>_StNN etc.) whose per-state game meaning is not researched; enemy/boss character identities; 297 Data_Bnn equates with mechanical consumer notes; generic object/boss fields (ObjVar418..4F4, BossVar508-50B); wave-script terminators; whole-bank generic data (banks 1-3, 8, most of 9). The audit tool cannot judge prose quality; this note records the agent's editorial review.
